en.headline: Watchdog hardening and a quota bug report in openchamber
en.summary: sogeisetsu made **7 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 9 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The work focused on the watchdog feature: expanding the fallback scope to a second workflow (the 30-day activity card) so each timeline is counted independently, making failures throw instead of being swallowed so that Invocations success rate can serve as an alert, and adding a BOM-stripping fallback for tokens along with a note on the secret pitfall. Two operational changes were added: a new Cloudflare Worker watchdog daily-report schedule and a cron tweak that avoids the top of the hour and adds a push trigger on this repo as a fallback. Two documentation/style commits swapped the flowchart font to Excalifont handwriting (fontFamily 5 -> 1) and added an Excalidraw runtime-path diagram for the watchdog. On the issue side, 3 issue actions were recorded, all on `openchamber/openchamber` issue #4537 about OpenCode Go quota showing "Provider not configured" while the Providers page shows an API key: the user opened the issue and then left two follow-up comments. `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied once, marking it `fix-ready` and confirming the two surfaces resolve OpenCode Go credentials differently on current main. No pull requests, reviews, releases, stars, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: Watchdog 加固与 openchamber 配额 Bug 反馈
zh.summary: sogeisetsu 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 提交了 **7 次本人提交**，另有 9 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。改动集中在 watchdog 功能：把兜底范围扩展到第二个 workflow（30 天活动卡片），两条时间线各自独立计数；失败不再吞错而是抛异常，让 Invocations 成功率充当告警；并为 token 增加去 BOM 兜底，同时补上 secret 踩坑记录。运维侧新增两项：Cloudflare Worker watchdog 兜底日报调度，以及 cron 避开整点并加上本仓 push 兜底触发。另有两次文档/样式提交，把流程图字体换成 Excalifont 手写体（fontFamily 5 -> 1），并为 watchdog 补了一张 Excalidraw 运行链路图。Issue 侧共 3 条动作，全部发生在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 #4537（OpenCode Go 配额显示 "Provider not configured" 而 Providers 页却显示已配置 API key）：用户先开了该 issue，随后又留下两条跟进评论。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复了一次，标记为 `fix-ready`，确认两个界面在当前 main 上解析 OpenCode Go 凭据的方式不同。当日无 PR、review、release、star 或 discussion 记录。
